apparatus.alt: Illustration of a water-filled aluminum can supported above a tea light, with a temperature probe in the water.
apparatus.caption: Apparatus illustration from the CORE 10 graphic. The stand supports the can independently. This is a diagram of the idea, not a photograph of a measured run.

picoscale.alt: Diagram connects the candle scale and water thermometer to a dashboard with a falling mass trace and rising temperature trace.
picoscale.caption: The archived PicoScale design drawing. The plot and displayed values are illustrative, not a recorded CSV.

candle-bench.alt: Archival photo of a tea light on a gravimetric test bench with scale and data-acquisition hardware.
candle-bench.caption: Actual bench photograph from the related candle-only gravimetry experiment. It documents the measurement lineage, not the pop-can setup. This historical rig is not a classroom safety template.

mass-endpoints.alt: Two measured candle mass endpoints are connected by a downward straight line over 12.5 minutes.
mass-endpoints.caption: Candle-only evidence from the Gravimetric Combustion Learning Guide, figure 3. The two end masses were measured. The straight line between them is an interpolation, not a continuous measured burn-rate trace.
